$comment: English texts of data/classes.json, by the class's id (src/engine/overlay.js). Draft names: the glossary (glossary.json) waits for the author's review (691 A).

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Fights in the front line with a heavy weapon and a shield. Takes a lot of punishment and rarely faints, but kills more slowly.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Shoots from the back line. Fast and accurate, but takes blows badly.

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: Casts elemental spells from the back line. Magic cannot be dodged or stopped by armour, but the mage is frail. The first steps are hard, and magic repays it in time.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: Wields the sacred. Rests better between fights, so long explorations are safer for him.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.description: Agile and elusive. Often lands critical hits and dodges blows, but has little HP.
